comparator.sourceNotes: Checked 2026-11-13. Current BA-LAGC confirms 45 EC first-year core + 85 EC major + 10 EC electives + 30 EC minor/additional electives/semester abroad + 10 EC Global Citizenship. Three first-year choice courses total 15 EC; one counts toward another requirement. They are not another 15 EC on top of the 180 EC framework. Seven original core units remain 45 EC, with Mathematics for Social Networks as one allowed maths choice. Add the independently established 10 + 30 + 10 EC categories without inventing specific electives, a minor or a Global Citizenship selection. The supported inventory is 95 EC; the remaining 85 EC major allocation is under review. CHS remains the neutral broad humanities/social-science major for the generic degree, selected before UCR matching. Current public CHS text and the 2026–2027 image grid confirm cultural expressions, historical processes, social forms, research design and a capstone. The annual major API expressly limits 15/40 EC to class2028 and 10/45 to classes2026/2027. Forward2271 returns current2261 bytes. Current capstone8004CS001Y is JSON null. Actual linked university-host PDF grid is404; old org/student-host guesses also404. The current public structure confirms supervised independent capstone research and cross-cultural Global Citizenship, and limits an internship to5EC; these known facts are not erased by the unresolved exact capstone load. Accessible OER/handbook are2025–2026, with old10EC thesis and final-semester120EC auto-enrolment; do not apply that progression to2029. The previous complete comparator and three UCR options are retained byte-exactly as research, not active unverified comparison/alignment. All56 actual current-UCR contributions and three feasible schedules remain reusable; prior DynamicEarth/EnergySustainability repair retained. No app or Excel changes.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target names the generic degree, not one major. The official product lists six majors. CHS combines humanities and social sciences across culture, history, politics, society, difference and research and is the least narrowly disciplinary expression of the broad identity; it is selected before UCR course search.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden University College The Hague studies global challenges such as sustainability, prosperity, diversity, peace and justice. In Culture, History and Society, students use the humanities and social sciences to examine how cultures, histories and social differences shape collective life.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 95 EC comprises the 45 EC first-year core, 10 EC of electives, 30 EC for a minor, further electives or study abroad, and 10 EC of Global Citizenship. The detailed 85 EC major requirements for students entering in September 2026, including the capstone and progression rules, still need confirmation. A complete comparison with UCR remains unfinished.

curriculum.limitation: Verified subset: 95 of 180 EC. The remaining 85 EC is the Culture, History and Society major. Its academic scope is known, but the catalogue gives different capstone and major-course credits for earlier graduating classes. The first-year choices count within the degree requirements and are not added again.

componentNotes.lagc06: One of the first-year mathematics choices.
componentNotes.elective-space-10: 10 EC of elective study within the degree framework. The first year also contains choices; these must be counted within the degree rather than added a second time.
componentNotes.flexible-space-30: 30 EC for a minor, additional electives or an approved semester abroad. The published programme places study abroad in the first semester of year three. An internship can contribute at most 5 EC under the published programme guidance.
componentNotes.global-citizenship-10: A 10 EC programme requirement developing cross-cultural communication and reflection. A specific language or Global Citizenship course is not selected in this partial inventory.
